heroTitle: Coach your way. Show the progress. End the evening questions from parents.
heroSubtitle: P.L.A.W is the first coaching app that doesn't push someone else's templates on you. Write down your own drills, follow every player's development in clear charts, and give parents read-only access to their practices.
showcaseSubtitle: Built for your phone — plan, log and analyze right on the court.

showcaseCaptions.session: A detailed log of every practice

featuresTitle: Everything you need, on the court and off it

features.title: Practice planning
features.description: Plan a practice in seconds, including duration and focus. If you've connected Google Calendar, the event gets added automatically.

features.title: Logging and review
features.description: After the practice, add the actual time and notes, and mark individual drills as skipped or swapped — the exact course of the practice stays on record. You can reorder drills anytime with the up/down arrows, as long as the practice is still planned.

features.title: Your own drill codes
features.description: It adapts to you, not the other way round. No preset templates — write down the drills you trust and coach exactly the way you believe in.

features.title: Analytics and charts
features.description: Data instead of gut feeling. No more chaos in notebooks and spreadsheets — the charts show you at a glance whether a player is improving and where the gaps are, in quality and in volume.

features.title: Sharing with players, parents and managers
features.description: No more long explanations after practice. Give the parent an access code and let the practice log speak for you — they see what their child worked on, you go home with a clear head.

features.title: Built for the phone
features.description: The app is designed mobile first, so it's comfortable to use right on the court, not just at a desk.

transparencyTitle: Show parents radical transparency (and earn their trust).
transparencyQuote: With P.L.A.W the practice log is yours. If our paths ever separate, the whole history stays in your account — including every practice we did together. You can let a new coach look through it with you whenever you want; nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is deleted.
transparencyNote: A coach who isn't afraid to put the data in the client's hands is a true professional. Raise your standing — and give them no reason to leave.
pricingSubtitle: 14 days to try it out, then it's paid. Every plan includes every feature — the only difference is how many players you keep active at once.
